_note: Run 4: Run 2 (supcon_ce_convnext_base_matched_schedule) with one change, a calibrated pair-level loss with held-out pairs added to the training loss. Each training step a random 10% of the training pairs play the unseen pairs: their images skip the factor cross-entropy, and a cross-entropy over the training pairs' scores (log P(crop) + log P(disease), seen pairs shifted down by gamma0 = 6.75, the gamma validation chose for Run 2) asks that the true pair wins. Motivation, from the deep analysis of Run 2 and the negative Run 3: the seen-versus-unseen decision is the largest loss (11.5 harmonic-mean points, AUROC 0.906) and a better rule on the same scores did not help, so the change has to be in training. Only training pairs are used, so no test or real-unseen information enters (the real unseen pairs are not candidates). Stage 1 is re-run in full because the training loss changed; epoch and gamma are chosen on the 3 validation splits as before. Everything else is as Run 2 (final fit matched to the validation schedule).
_result: Run 4. Test HM Top-1 70.94 / Top-5 92.97; seen 63.05 (Top-5 87.60), unseen 81.08 (Top-5 99.03) calibrated; raw seen 72.80, raw unseen 12.09; 21.2% of seen images sent to unseen pairs (Run 2: 29.2%). Epoch 17, gamma 7.25, validation HM 61.27 (per split 60.32 / 58.69 / 64.80; Run 2: 59.15, 53.56 / 59.44 / 64.46). Versus Run 2 (HM 67.28 / 93.29): +3.7 Top-1, level on Top-5; seen +6.3, unseen -1.5. Seen-versus-unseen separation improved (AUROC 0.906 to 0.919; HM ceiling 78.8 to 80.2; loss to the decision 11.5 to 9.3). Just above the roughly 3 points of run-to-run noise, supported by validation (+2.1) but a single seed; and the stopping epoch also changed (17 against 6), so the gain is not purely the loss term. Close to the independent ConvNeXt-Base baseline (HM 71.44 / 93.26; seen 67.0, unseen 76.5).

model._note: ConvNeXt-Base from timm, ImageNet-22k pretraining then 1k fine-tuning; drop_path_rate is stochastic depth. ce_dropout matches the baseline's head dropout.

input._note: Bicubic resizing, as ConvNeXt was pretrained.

augmentation._note: Same as the independent ConvNeXt-Base baseline.

loss._note: CHANGED: pair_loss adds weight * CE over the training pairs' calibrated scores; holdout_frac of the pairs are pretend-unseen each step (their images skip the factor CE if mask_ce_on_holdout); gamma0 shifts the other pairs' scores.

scoring._note: CHANGED: mode heads, the cross-entropy heads' log-probabilities. temperature is only used for the prototypes saved alongside.

optimizer._note: As the independent ConvNeXt-Base baseline (lr_head also covers the projection and cross-entropy heads).

training._note: final_schedule match_validation as in Run 2. No saved validation grid is reused: stage 1 runs in full because the training loss changed.

runtime._note: grad_checkpointing: recompute backbone activations in the backward pass; identical gradients, less GPU memory, somewhat slower. Needed because ConvNeXt-Base with 128 views per step did not fit in 16 GB.
